court: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
case_name: Sau. Anita W/O Santosh Dande And Another vs Santosh S/O Ramrao Dande And Another

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Priti w/o Ravindra Bhange, Mukund s/o Pundlikrao Mahale (sister and brother)
parties.respondent_defendant: State of Maharashtra through the Police Station Officer, Shankarrao s/o Gunnaji Bhange

facts_of_case: Priti lodged report with Police Station against her husband Ravindra. She was treated nicely for first 20 days after marriage, then there was a demand of Rs.5,00,000/- to her by the accused persons. The ill treatment became unbearable and Priti called her brother Mukund and was driven out of her matrimonial house.

legal_principles.principle: The burden lies on the applicant to prove that the allegations made in the complaint are without any substance.
legal_principles.held: According to the learned counsel for the applicants, even taking the allegations in the complaint lodged by non applicant no.2, no case is made out for the offence under section 306 of the IPC.

legal_principles.principle: A court should exercise its powers under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. to quash a FIR if no case is made out for the offence.
legal_principles.held: He, therefore, submitted that this Court should exercise the powers under Section 482 of the Cr.P.C. and prayed for quashing of the FIR.

outcome.final_order: The court allowed the appeal and granted relief to the applicants.
